concepts.title: Atlas (Kimi)
concepts.design_contract_summary: Directory IA: search-crowned annotated directory home; three-region workspace (outline/document/context gutter); master-detail managers (Providers, Memory, MCP).

impacts.requirement: Row-state vocabulary (Default/Recommended/Inherited/Auto/Not configured/Managed/Custom/Unavailable/Effective value differs) on every ordinary setting.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Every row renders a text+icon state badge plus a value-source line; session edits become Custom with reset-to-default.
slint_notes: badge is a row-level widget, no custom paint
notes: Recorded only; nothing applied to canon.

impacts.requirement: Persistent navigation region with search above it; scrollspy synchronized to the document.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Left outline with embedded search; IntersectionObserver-driven active section; controlled jumps with focus settle.
slint_notes: needs a scroll-position model, not DOM geometry

impacts.requirement: Assistant memory Gists expose verified/awaiting-review, pinning, half-life (fading), evidence, and versions.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Memory manager renders all of these with verify/pin/discard/restore actions (simulated).
notes: Half-life language is 'fades from active context', never 'expires'.

concepts.title: Constellation (Kimi)
concepts.design_contract_summary: Command-center IA: query-first home that reshapes into ranked results; docked query + segmented destination bar + section minimap in workspace; mission-surface Providers manager; Context & Instructions and Terminal managers.

impacts.requirement: A global, keyboard-first settings search with verbs and deep links.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: '/' focuses the command field from anywhere; Enter runs the top result; results carry Open/Fix/Resume verbs.
wiring_routes: command palette parity with settings search
slint_notes: minimap ticks need a small custom painted element

impacts.requirement: Context & Instructions must show admitted/omitted sources with reasons and provenance without exposing a raw prompt.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Ledger of last-turn admission with per-source reasons; advanced area shows hashes/strategy as quiet code lines.
wiring_routes: context admission events feed the ledger
notes: Event shape is a proposal; canonical owner is the context engine plan.

impacts.requirement: Terminal profiles need explicit Auto/Inherit/Not-configured states, never ambiguous empty fields.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Partial Work profile renders explicit chips; live preview restyles instantly on edit.
slint_notes: preview is a styled text view; portable

concepts.title: Ledger (Kimi)
concepts.design_contract_summary: Document IA: editorial front page with annotated index; single reading column with floating TOC + progress; appendix-style Providers, Personas, and Skills/Plugins/Tools managers.

impacts.requirement: Persona scopes are explicit (turn/thread/goal/project/global/child) and child-only personas never appear as ordinary Chat defaults.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Scope select per persona with child-only personas locked to Child only and an explanation line.

impacts.requirement: Skills, plugins, tools, and commands stay related but distinct; tool exposure is progressive; MCP-owned tools stay attributed.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: One appendix with four clearly separated inventories; MCP-owned tools labeled 'via MCP server'; conflict remap demo for commands.

concepts.title: Workbench (Kimi)
concepts.design_contract_summary: Ops-console IA: status-band ops board with instrument panels; accordion nav + sticky section headers; control-room Providers with diagnostics drawer; Crew and Media managers.

impacts.requirement: Crew templates preserve requested versus effective composition; capacity advisories come from Usage/Orchestrator as read-only operational state.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Seat-block visual (R effective / Q queued) with waves and a provider-reset warning banner; route policy is editable, composition edit is receipted.
slint_notes: seat map is a row of simple rectangles; portable

impacts.requirement: Media providers need route/purpose assignment, native vs PM-transformed input, output policy, safety status, cost route, fallback, and history.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Routes board with a per-kind matrix, safety badge, fallback select (persisted), setup receipt for the unconfigured provider, history log.
notes: One unqualified 'Free' badge is never used as the whole contract.

cross_concept_findings: All four concepts converge on the same shared needs: the 11-category humanized taxonomy, the 9-state row vocabulary with a value source, 6 exposure levels with disclosure, and a common manager shell (search/filter, health summary, rows with requested/effective, logs). These are candidates for Plans-level canon.

Search deep-link contract (result -> load owner category -> controlled jump -> non-flashing focus treatment) behaved identically across concepts; candidate for a shared wiring route (settings.revealSetting).

Provider/account/connection/product/model separation plus humanized connection groups proved sufficient for every required state, including CLI-owned OAuth isolation and Free Models as a grouping; candidate for the canonical provider schema.
Spellcheck behaved as a quiet shared service in all four concepts (no toolbar button, no autocorrect, code/path skipping); production needs the Slint-portable spelling-service abstraction.
Inventory conflict (uncertainty: medium): if the current inventory treats Free Models as a credential-owning provider, the packet's grouping model supersedes it.
PMConcept7 Spotlight keeps category chips and a one-category bloom; all four concepts supersede that with destination rows/cards and a full workspace (recorded, not applied).

All four concepts render the 11 agent role assignments as route selects with quality-guard constraints (Main Assistant and PRD/Planning never silently downgrade). Candidate command: roles.assignRoute; role state needs route/status persistence.
